Technician observations, not an automatic diagnosis. Component-specific instructions are draft reference material; confirm against the vehicle service manual. Do not handle hot, moving or energised parts. “Checked” records an action, not a pass.

AI labels and scores are suggestions, not fault or safety conclusions. Check results and notes are entered by the technician. An unseen component is not necessarily absent or faulty. Reference instructions are drafts and require review against the vehicle service manual.
